verdict.rationale: Fastmail's own help center has a 'Searching your mail' article, so mail search is a documented first-party feature. The pack contains only the article title, though, with nothing on search operators, filters, ranking, or full-history coverage. The only hands-on report on speed says search was 'much slower' than Gmail, which undercuts the 'fast' part of the story. Missing for 10: documented search operators and filter syntax, ranked or relevance-ordered results, confirmation of full-history indexing, and positive independent evidence of search speed.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history
